checks.description: Sales never exceed the funded order or real supply
The external buyer pays the recorded sales revenue once
The firm's recorded revenue equals the external receipt
The buyer cannot spend beyond its opening funds
Recorded payroll equals workers' gross wage receipts
Live employment links agree with the business roster
Closing the firm releases its workers
All numeric weekly observations are finite
